MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 22

2. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 10

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 30

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

11. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
